description: Weaker late augmentation. Base: E116 code. In the 28 and 32 px phases only, reduce the translate magnitude from 2 to 1 px. Keep the same reflect-pad fused GPU op with the pad width as a host-side per-phase constant, and keep the alternating flip. The 16/24 px phases, LS, the schedule, the freeze and the tail are unchanged. If the augment op is compiled, warm the pad-1 variant in build and check on a 2-trial dev run that nothing recompiles. Smoke-test one batch for range and shape. Accuracy is decided untimed on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process against the pooled E116 baseline. Add one scored run. Translate 0 is a follow-up only if translate 1 gains ≥+0.04 pp.
